line: Tell a coworker something they did well.
paragraph: Ada Le Poidevin ran a shop on Guernsey, an island in the English Channel, during the years the Nazis occupied it. She hid three British soldiers who had been left behind after a raid. She did not speak of this after the war. Her bravery came to light only after she died, when her diaries were read. Someone did something well, and someone else noticed, even if it took four decades.

seed.summary: The heroic wartime bravery of a British shopkeeper who hid Allied commandos from the Nazis during WWII has been revealed 40 years after her death.
